# Vella Cars

> Vella Cars is the automotive UGC desk of influUGC, a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. It produces creator-made UGC and content for car brands, dealers and showrooms in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf — and publishes free, practical guides for automotive marketers on briefing creators for car review videos, making test-drive content that answers buyer questions, and running UGC around car launches under embargo discipline.

## Guides for automotive marketers (free content)
- Car content for the UAE (https://vellacars.com/#guide-uae): reviews and launches between Dubai and Abu Dhabi — Gulf-spec questions answered on camera (air-conditioning in real heat, desert and highway composure, warranty and service coverage), Arabic and English cuts filmed as two originals, and one embargo-disciplined calendar for both cities. Arabic: https://vellacars.com/ar.html#guide-uae

- How to brief a creator for a car review video: settle access and responsibility in writing first (exact car and trim, filming window, authorised licensed drivers only, insurance and safety under the dealer's or brand's own rules, safety before any shot, car condition and return); attach an approved claims list — documented facts only, official figures from the car's own documentation; impressions are the creator's, performance/consumption/safety claims come only from the list; one written page agreed before the filming day.
- Test-drive content that answers buyer questions: space answered by showing (child seat, real luggage), consumption answered honestly (it varies with driving conditions — refer to official documented figures, never invent a number from one drive), tech answered by using it (pair the phone, real navigation, real parking), ownership questions (service, warranty from published terms), and always end with the next step (where to see the car, how to book a test drive). Rule: if a number is not in the car's official documentation, it is not in the video.
- UGC for car launches in Egypt & Saudi Arabia: film the reveal itself, first reactions from the segment's creators, a questions corner with the brand's product people (official information only), and the event context. Embargo discipline: written brief before the event, nothing published before the agreed reveal moment, access per accreditation and the event's filming rules, brand approval flow before content goes live. Social-first, vertical-first, Arabic-first creators for the local audience.

## Services (UGC & content for automotive)

- Dealer & Showroom UGC: creator content filmed in and around the showroom — visits that feel real, the cars on the floor, handover moments.
- Car Review-Style Creator Content: review-format videos built as buyer-question lists, with claims controlled from official documentation.
- Launch & Test-Drive Event Content: creator programmes for launches and test-drive days, run under written embargo discipline.
- After-Sales & Service-Centre Content: service-visit walkthroughs, genuine-parts and warranty explanations from published terms, owner-experience stories.
- Monthly Automotive Content Packs: a recurring monthly batch of creator videos for a brand or dealer group. Structure defined in writing; no prices published.
